contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Providentiae Augg issue of 327-328, Trier mint, RIC volume 7 no. 504, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Bust laureate right. Obverse inscription: [---]INVS [--]. reverse description: Camp gate with two towers, six courses of masonry, star above. Reverse inscription: PROVID[EN] TIAE AVGG. In exergue: PTRE.
